headline: Approved permission to enter and entered executive session to discuss personnel and bargaining matters
summary: The committee approved permission to enter the meeting and then recessed into executive session to discuss collective bargaining, a sick leave buyback claim, principal contract terms, and data office personnel negotiations. The meeting adjourned from executive session.
decisions: Approved the Permission to Enter for August 4, 2026, with 6 yeas and 1 absent.

plain_text:
Lowell Public Schools • 155 Merrimack Street • Lowell, MA 01852 • http://www.lowell.k12.ma.us 
 
LOWELL SCHOOL COMMITTEE 
REGULAR MEETING MINUTES 
, 2025 
 
 
 
 
 
Date: August 4, 2026 
Time: 5:30PM 
Location: Mayor's Reception Room, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852 
____________________________________________________________________________________ 
Members of the public can view the meeting via LTC.  Those wishing to speak about a specific agenda 
item must register in advance by emailing the Superintendent.  Please include the agenda item, as well 
as your phone number and email address so we can provide a Zoom link for access. The email address is 
skeo@lowell.k12.ma.us. If you do not have access to email, you may contact us at 978-674-4324. All 
requests must be submitted by 2:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. 
 
 
1. SALUTE TO FLAG 
 
2. ROLL CALL 
 
On a call at 5:31 p.m., members present were, namely: Mr. Conway, Ms. Delrossi, Mayor Gitschier, 
Mr. Lay, Ms. Martin (on Zoom) and Ms. McFadden.  Mr. Bahou arrived at 5:32 p.m. 
 
3. PERMISSION TO ENTER 
 
3.1. Permission to Enter - August 4, 2026 
 
Mr. Lay moved to approve the Permission to Enter; the motion was seconded by Ms. McFadden. The 
motion passed with 6 yeas, 1 absent (Ms. Delrossi). 
 
4. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
 
3.1. An Executive Session may be called to discuss collective bargaining, strategies and/or possible litigation 
under Open Meeting Law, Chapter 30A, Section 21 (A) (B), 2, 3 of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts 
General Laws. Open meeting discussion may have a detrimental effect on the bargaining or litigating position 
of the public body. 
Items: 
1. Consideration of Terms of Employment of Unaffiliated Personnel and request for Donated Sick 
Days Benefit available other employees;  
2. Consideration of Proposal related to Contract of Principals to allow temporary assignment to 
another school; 
3.  Consideration of claim related to Sick Leave Buyback; 
4.  Negotiations related to Data Office personnel and proposals.
(Page 2 of 2) 
 
Lowell Public Schools • 155 Merrimack Street • Lowell, MA 01852 • http://www.lowell.k12.ma.us 
 
 
Mr. Bahou moved to recess at 5:33 p.m. and to enter into Executive Session for the purpose of 
discussing collective bargaining, strategies and/or possible litigation under open meeting law, Chapter 
30A, Section 21 (A) (B), 2, 3 of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts General Laws for consideration of 
terms of employment of unaffiliated staff and request for donated sick days benefit available to other 
employees, consideration of proposal related to contract of principals to allow temporary assignment 
to another school, consideration of claim related to sick leave buyback, and negotiations related to 
data office personnel and proposals, of which open meeting discussion may have a detrimental effect 
on the bargaining or litigating position of the public body, and to adjourn from Executive Session; the 
motion was seconded by Ms. Martin. The motion passed with 7 yeas. 
5. ADJOURNMENT 
 
Mr. Bahou moved to recess at 5:33 p.m.; the motion was seconded by Ms. Martin. The motion passed 
with 7 yeas. 
 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Liam Skinner, Superintendent and 
Secretary to the Lowell School Committee
